nodes.summary: For every $\varepsilon > 0$ there is $\delta > 0$ such that for all natural numbers $n$ and $r$ with $\varepsilon n < r < (1/2 - \varepsilon) n$, every family $\mathcal{F}$ of subsets of $\{1, \dots, n\}$ with $|A \cap B| \ne r$ for all $A, B \in \mathcal{F}$ (including $A = B$) has $|\mathcal{F}| < (2 - \delta)^n$. This answers the second question of Erdős Problem 703 in the affirmative.
nodes.title: Frankl–Rödl forbidden intersection theorem
